_doc: The Bloom on the land (ADR-0025, BloomField / BloomWorld / BloomMounds). Zones are authored as region features ({"type": "bloom", "at" | "points" | "poi"+"offset", "radius", "strength", "edge"}, docs/REGIONS.md); this file shapes them and adds the per-POI defaults.

field._doc: texel: grid spacing (m) of the hm_bloom_map shader global. Each zone's radius swells and shrinks along its boundary (lobe x radius, one lobe per lobe_len x radius of boundary) and shoots out tongues (up to tongue x edge radii, tongue_len x radius apart); the point is warped (warp x radius, wavelength warp_scale x radius) so the tongues bend, the edge frays at edge_scale m (depth edge x 0.35 radii; edge is the default when a zone sets none), the value fades over softness x radius either side of the edge and is mottled inside (mottle, mottle_scale m). spot_reach: how far past its radius a dynamic spot (a rooting mound) spreads.

poi_defaults._doc: POI def -> a zone every standalone placement of it carries, unless the region anchors its own bloom feature to that placement. offset: metres from the footprint centre in the building's frame (+x along its width, +z toward its front).

tamsin_clinic._doc: Cordon Medical held the sick in the isolation ward and took the dead out by the rear ambulance bay: the back lot is where it took.

tamsin_logging_camp._doc: Six crew quarantined in the bunkhouse; the foreman slept over there with them.

mounds._doc: Dawn rooting (DESIGN §6): a Hum survivor that roots into the soil leaves a fungal mound (BloomMounds, WorldState.mounds). It swells for grow_hours, then shrinks and pales until lifetime_days, when it is gone. Around it the ground takes the Bloom (a dynamic spot of radius m and strength). Harvesting tears it open for bloom_mycelium, with a chance of a core sample.
